v8-10:1.question: Why would the man of God not eat with the king?
v8-10:1.answer: The Lord had commanded him not to eat or drink there.
v8-10:1.reason: States the specific refusal and the relevant part of the command in the key.

v11-14:1.question: What did the old prophet do just before speaking to the man of God?
v11-14:1.answer: He found the man of God sitting under an oak tree.
v11-14:1.reason: Completes the original stem’s unfinished-sounding phrase while keeping the encounter and its order.

v31-32:1.question: What reason did the father give his sons for wanting to be buried beside the man of God?
v31-32:1.answer: He was certain the man of God’s message from the Lord would come true.
v31-32:1.reason: Identifies the speaker through his sons and distinguishes him from the man of God he buried.
